records.name: Zeitreisender Schonmorgen
records.biography_en: Has arrived just in time to miss the reason for coming. His bent HyperNorm clock keeps appointments with events that have already changed their minds. A dissonant card asks whether arriving late can also mean leaving early. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ankunft liegt knapp hinter ihrem Anlass.

variant_notes.note_en: Has arrived just in time to miss the reason for coming.

records.name: Fraktalin Ebenfalls
records.biography_en: Recognizes herself in the explanation and suspects that is the problem. Her nested HyperNorm mirrors confirm the same conclusion at smaller scales. A dissonant card asks whether repetition is the same as an independent view. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gegenprüfung erkennt sich selbst erfreulich zuverlässig wieder.

variant_notes.note_en: Recognizes herself in the explanation and suspects that is the problem.

records.name: Ritter Übermorgen
records.biography_en: Defends a future that keeps revising the terms of its rescue. His HyperNorm shield defends tomorrow from unapproved possibilities. A dissonant card asks who will be allowed to decide when tomorrow arrives. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Rettung gilt vorbehaltlich der künftigen Bedingungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Defends a future that keeps revising the terms of its rescue.

records.name: Kubenkind Mehrraum
records.biography_en: Has found another inside and would like to know where to put it. His nested HyperNorm cube has more inside than the storage policy permits. A dissonant card offers another way of counting the available room. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der zusätzliche Innenraum benötigt eine eigene Außenstelle.

variant_notes.note_en: Has found another inside and would like to know where to put it.

records.name: Opa Rückwirklich
records.biography_en: Remembers teaching himself a lesson he has not learned yet. His hourglass files HyperNorm memories under things still to come. A dissonant card asks whether he remembers being wrong before he became certain. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Erfahrung wurde rückwirkend zur Voraussetzung erklärt.

variant_notes.note_en: Remembers teaching himself a lesson he has not learned yet.

records.name: Maskottchen Allesdabei
records.biography_en: Promises everything required for a beginning that has already got complicated. Her HyperNorm kit promises that everything starts with the right objects. A dissonant card asks whether bewilderment is included or has to be supplied separately. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Anfang ist vollständig ausgestattet und bereits erklärungsbedürftig.

variant_notes.note_en: Promises everything required for a beginning that has already got complicated.
